summary: Add a lazy-loaded agent skill describing when and how to run `gh plate ci audit` and read waiting, setup, and running minutes (#1301).
migration_impact: Bootstrapped repos receive `.agentic/skills/ci-audit/SKILL.md` on import-payload. The CI speed checklist links to the skill; no baseline catalog or workflow changes.
migration_guidance: Run `gh plate import-payload` (or bootstrap) to copy `.agentic/skills/ci-audit/SKILL.md`.
When improving CI speed, read the skill from docs/migration/ci-speed-checklist.md before baselining minutes.
Requires `gh plate` with the ci audit command (#1282); see docs/design/ci-audit-command.md in plate-core for heuristics.
agent_notes: Lazy-load `.agentic/skills/ci-audit/SKILL.md` only for CI speed or minutes baselining work—not for ordinary feature loops. Measure with `gh plate ci audit [--json]`; treat cache hint_* fields as name-based guesses.
